headword: ホラー{小説|しょうせつ}

definitions.explanation: A novel or written work in the horror genre, intended to frighten or unsettle the reader.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ホラー{小説|しょうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a horror novel before going to bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ホラー{小説|しょうせつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実話|じつわ}→実話：15897_jitsuwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいている→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: This horror novel is based on a true story.

examples.english: Japanese horror novels have a unique atmosphere and are popular overseas in translation.

notes:
A compound of the loanword ⟦ホラー→ホラー：22730_horaa⟧ (horror, from English) and ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (novel). Japanese horror literature ({和製|わせい}⟦ホラー→ホラー：22730_horaa⟧ or J⟦ホラー→ホラー：22730_horaa⟧) is known for its atmospheric, psychological approach, often drawing on traditional ghost stories (⟦{怪談|かいだん}→怪談：12608_kaidan⟧) and urban legends (⟦{都市伝説|としでんせつ}→都市伝説：28748_toshidensetsu⟧). Notable authors include {鈴木光司|すずきこうじ} (Ring) and {小野不由美|おのふゆみ}.
